dialogue.origin: （こんにちわ　本日はよろしくお願い致します）
dialogue.content: (Hello, thank you for coming in today.)

dialogue.origin: (宜しくお願いします。少々お待ちください)
dialogue.content: (Thank you. Please give me a moment.)

dialogue.origin: （はい、お時間まだありますので大丈夫ですよ）
dialogue.content: (Of course, we still have plenty of time, so it's alright.)

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です
dialogue.content: I'm ready now.

dialogue.origin: では改めましてよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Alright then, let's begin. Thank you for being here.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 本日相談員をさせていただきます今日はお越しくださいましてありがとうございますまずは年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: I will be your counselor today. Thank you for coming. First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 38歳　女性です
dialogue.content: I'm 38 years old and female.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 主人が暇があればゲームばかりして、うんざりしています
dialogue.content: My husband is always playing video games whenever he has free time, and I'm fed up with it.

dialogue.origin: それは嫌になってしまいますね夫さんはどのくらいの頻度でゲームをするのですか？
dialogue.content: That must be frustrating. How often does your husband play games?

dialogue.origin: 毎日です
dialogue.content: Every day.

dialogue.origin: 途中ですがお名前何とお呼びしたらいいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I'm sorry to interrupt, but what should I call you?

dialogue.origin: あなたで大丈夫です
dialogue.content: You don't need to use a name.

dialogue.origin: 毎日というのは仕事から帰ってきてという理解でよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: When you say every day, do you mean after he gets home from work?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: そんなにゲームに熱中してしまうのですね　あなたはちなみにどのようなゲームかはご存じなのですか？
dialogue.content: So he gets that absorbed in his games. By the way, do you happen to know what kind of games they are?

dialogue.origin: よく分かりませんが、ゲームの中の人と話しながらやってます
dialogue.content: I don't really know, but he plays while talking with people in the game.

dialogue.origin: 話ができるのですね　あなたはその中に入っていっしょにされた事はあるのですか？
dialogue.content: So he can talk with them. Have you ever joined him and played together?

dialogue.origin: ありません。興味も無いです
dialogue.content: No, I haven't. And I'm not interested.

dialogue.origin: 興味が無かったら楽しめないですよねゲームはいつ頃からはじまったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Of course, you can't enjoy it if you're not interested. When did he start playing games like this?

dialogue.origin: 3年位前から徐々に増えた感じです
dialogue.content: It feels like it started gradually increasing about three years ago.

dialogue.origin: もう３年も！　あなたは取り残された感じになりますよね
dialogue.content: It's been 3 years already! You must feel left out.

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, I do.

dialogue.origin: その期間　夫さんと会話は普通にあったりしていたのですか？
dialogue.content: During that time, have you been having normal conversations with your husband?

dialogue.origin: どういうのが普通かは分かりませんが、会話はあります
dialogue.content: I'm not sure what counts as 'normal,' but we do talk.

dialogue.origin: 食事も一緒にできたり、あなたのお話などは聞いてくれたりしているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do you have meals together, and does he listen when you talk?

dialogue.origin: 私の話はどうでしょうか。余り興味は無さそうかな
dialogue.content: When it comes to my stories... I don't think he seems very interested.

dialogue.origin: 私もあまり話さないし
dialogue.content: And I don't talk much either.

dialogue.origin: それは寂しくもなりますよね話をしたくなくなったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: That can feel lonely. Have you found yourself not wanting to talk?

dialogue.origin: さぁ、分かりませんがゲームの方が面白いんだと思いますよ
dialogue.content: Well, I don't know. I think he just finds the games more interesting.

dialogue.origin: 最近はゲームも進化しているので楽しめるのでしょうねご家族はその他にいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.content: Games have become quite advanced recently, so I imagine they can be enjoyable. Do you have any other family members?

dialogue.origin: 3歳の娘がいます
dialogue.content: We have a three-year-old daughter.

dialogue.origin: かわいい盛りですね
dialogue.content: That’s such a delightful age.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: お子さんのお世話は主にあなたがされているのですか？
dialogue.content: Are you primarily the one caring for your child?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, I am.

dialogue.origin: お仕事はされているのですか？
dialogue.content: Are you working?

dialogue.origin: いいえ
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: 今日のご相談で夫さんとの関係について、何が一番気がかりでしょうか？
dialogue.content: In our discussion today about your relationship with your husband, what is your biggest concern?

dialogue.origin: ずっと暇さえあればゲームしてる事です
dialogue.content: It's that he's always playing games whenever he has a free moment.

dialogue.origin: 最初に言った通りです
dialogue.content: Just as I said at the beginning.

dialogue.origin: ゲームを取り上げたら、どのような感じになるのかな？
dialogue.content: What do you think would happen if you took his games away?

dialogue.origin: 怒ると思います
dialogue.content: I think he'd get angry.

dialogue.origin: あなたは以前に夫さんに注意などはされましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you ever addressed this with him or asked him to stop?

dialogue.origin: はい。注意というか、やめてほしいと。でも、変わりません
dialogue.content: Yes. Not so much 'warned' him, but I have asked him to stop. It doesn’t change anything.

dialogue.origin: それはイライラしてきますね今後まだ続くとなるとどのようなお気持ちになりますか？
dialogue.content: That must be frustrating. If this continues, how do you imagine you will feel?

dialogue.origin: うんざりですね
dialogue.content: I'd be fed up.

dialogue.origin: 少しまとめさせてくださいね
dialogue.content: Let me try to summarize, if that's okay.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんはこの３年間仕事から帰宅するなり、ほとんどあなたと会話もせず、ゲームに夢中になっています
dialogue.content: For the past three years, as soon as your husband gets home from work, he gets absorbed in his games, and there's very little conversation between you.

dialogue.origin: あなたは専業主婦で３歳の娘さんのお世話をする毎日で、ゲームに夢中になっている夫さんにはうんざいしてしまってる状態ですね
dialogue.content: You're a full-time homemaker taking care of your three-year-old daughter every day, and you're feeling fed up with your husband being so engrossed in his games.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたはゲームには興味がないので夫さんとゲームをする気にはなれない夫さんのゲームを取り上げたら怒るので今後どうしたらいいものかとお悩みなのですね
dialogue.content: You're not interested in games, so you don't feel like playing with your husband. But if you were to take his games away, he would get angry, so you're wondering what to do. Is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今まとめてみてあなたのお気持ちは毎日子育てに疲れ、夫さんからの手助けもなく一人で寂しいのではないかと思いますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: From what you’ve shared, it sounds like you’re exhausted from daily childcare, lacking support from your husband, and feeling lonely. Does that resonate with you?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。寂しいですけど、どうしたらいいのか、もう分からないんです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right. I do feel lonely, but I just don't know what to do anymore.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: そうですね　分からなくなってしまいますね
dialogue.content: I see. It's understandable that you feel at a loss.

dialogue.origin: はい。それで相談にきました
dialogue.content: Yes. That’s why I came for counseling.

dialogue.origin: 一生懸命に子育てをしてきて、唯一の理解者である夫さんが離れていったら不安になると思います一緒に考えていきましょうね
dialogue.content: You've been working so hard to raise your child, and it must feel unsettling when the one person who should be your biggest support seems to be drifting away. Let's think about this together.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: たどってみれば娘さんが３歳ということで、ゲームが始まったのもその子が生まれた頃からですよね
dialogue.content: If we trace it back, with your daughter being three, the gaming started around the time she was born, is that correct?

dialogue.origin: あなたは初めての出産で必死に子育てをしていたと思います
dialogue.content: I imagine you were putting all your energy into raising your first child.

dialogue.origin: その前からもしてはいたんですが、スマホでした。3年前から、オンライン？で会話しながらのゲームになってから、のめり込んだような
dialogue.content: He had been playing before that too, but on his smartphone. About three years ago, when it became an online game where he talks with people while playing, he seems to have gotten more immersed.

dialogue.origin: うんうん本来夫さんはゲーム好きなんですね
dialogue.content: I see. So your husband has always been a fan of games.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんもまだ子供気分が抜けきれないのかな
dialogue.content: Maybe your husband still has a bit of a childish side.

dialogue.origin: あなたが愛娘に手を取られて、夫さんは寂しい思いをゲームに逃げているのかなと思いますがどう思われますか？
dialogue.content: Since your attention has been focused on your beloved daughter, I wonder if your husband might be feeling lonely and escaping into games. What do you think about that?

dialogue.origin: どうでしょうか。ゲームをしてる人が子供っぽいとは限らないと思います。ゲームの世界は大人が沢山参加してますから。子供気分だから、ゲームを取り上げたら解決するとかは、考えた事がありません。
dialogue.content: I'm not so sure. I don't think people who play games are necessarily childish. There are lots of adults in the gaming world. I've never thought that it's just a matter of him being childish and that taking away the games would solve everything.

dialogue.origin: 確かにそうですね私もゲームはしますただ童心に帰っている感じではあるのですが　最近は大人もはまってしまいますね
dialogue.content: You have a point. I play games myself, and while for me it feels like returning to childhood, it's true that adults can get very absorbed in them these days.

dialogue.origin: 今後夫さんがゲームをやめてくれたらあなたはうれしいですか？
dialogue.content: Would you be happy if your husband stopped playing games in the future?

dialogue.origin: それはそうですが…すみません。貴方は童心に帰る感じかもなんでしょうが、主人はそんなのでは無い様に思います。何となく、一緒だとされるのが、ちょっと違うかんじです。
dialogue.content: Well, yes, but... I'm sorry. Perhaps for you it feels like returning to childhood, but I don't think it's like that for my husband. I just feel that lumping them together isn't quite right.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね夫さんのゲームは大人がする感覚のゲームととらえたらいいのですね
dialogue.content: I see. So it would be better to see your husband's gaming as something done from an adult perspective?

dialogue.origin: いえ、そうではなくで…楽しくてしているのではなくて、現実逃避の手段なのでは無いかと
dialogue.content: No, that's not it... I think he's not doing it for fun, but rather as a means of escaping reality.

dialogue.origin: そうお感じなのですね
dialogue.content: That's how you feel.

dialogue.origin: いえ、主人がそう言った事があります。
dialogue.content: No—my husband has said that himself.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: だから、余計にどうしたらいいか分からないのです
dialogue.content: That's why I'm even more at a loss as to what to do.

dialogue.origin: 夫さんの現実逃避だというお話がでたときに、戸惑われたのですね
dialogue.content: When the idea of it being an escape from reality came up, it left you feeling at a loss.

dialogue.origin: はい。でも、そんな事言われても、だからっていつもゲームをしていいかどうか
dialogue.content: Yes. But even if he says that, does it mean it's okay for him to always be playing games?

dialogue.origin: そうですよねそう思うのも当然だと思います
dialogue.content: Of course. It's completely natural for you to feel that way.

dialogue.origin: 現実的に困っているので
dialogue.content: Because it's causing real problems for me.

dialogue.origin: ずっとあなたは一人で頑張っているのだと思います
dialogue.content: I believe you've been managing this all by yourself for a long time.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: もう少しお話を続けたいと思いますが、お時間が来てしまいました
dialogue.content: I would like to continue our conversation, but it seems our time is up for today.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 是非また相談にいらしていただけませんか？夫さんの現実逃避について詳しくお話をさせていただければと思います
dialogue.content: Would you be willing to come in for another session? I'd like to talk more in detail about your husband's escapism.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ　ご相談ありがとうございましたこれからも一緒に考えて行きましょう
dialogue.content: Thank you as well for consulting with me. Let’s continue to think this through together.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 失礼します
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: 失礼します
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: 終了メッセージを送りますね
dialogue.content: I will send the session closing message now.

topic.sub: 夫のゲーム依存によるコミュニケーション不足
